items.headline: Visa Taps $MONAD for Stablecoin Settlement
items.summary: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for issuers and acquirers, a major TradFi nod for the high-performance L1 and its $MONAD ecosystem.

items.headline: $PUMP Adds Cross Margin to Hyperliquid Perps
items.summary: Pump.fun upgraded its Hyperliquid-powered perps with cross margin, TWAP execution and manual margin tweaks, just two weeks after launch. $PUMP keeps shipping.

items.headline: $JUP Launches Token Baskets & Yield Vaults
items.summary: Jupiter rolled out token baskets and curator-run yield vaults, letting users automate strategies from individual vaults. A fresh DeFi use case for $JUP.

items.headline: $PENDLE Lists Four Fixed-Term USDe Markets
items.summary: Pendle opened four new fixed-term USDe markets on Ethereum with quoted yields of 5.24%–6.00%, expanding its yield-trading footprint for $PENDLE holders.

items.headline: $MEGA Rebrands, Pledges $30M to AI Push
items.summary: MegaETH Foundation rebranded to MEGA and committed $30M from treasury to new products, starting with an AI inference marketplace due in December.
